verses.text: ¿Tas wal yuj tz'el wek'ek'ok yaw heb' ch'ok chonhab'il sk'echa'anh? ¿Tas wal yuj slajti'ej sb'a heb' t'a junok tas manh ol tzak'wan heb' sb'o'ani?
Ha heb' winh rey yet' heb' yajal t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', schichonoch sk'o'ol heb', junlajanxonhej syutej slajti'an sb'a heb' yoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová yet' t'a Winh Rey Sik'b'ilel yuj.
Slaj yalan heb' icha tik: Kik'ekel ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Dios yik manhxalaj yalan yik t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a satcha'anh tonhej stzetzaj wal heb' yuj, sb'uchji heb' yuj.
Skot yowal t'a heb', xib'taj heb' yuj. Yet' yowal sk'o'ol ol yalan t'a heb' icha tik:
Toxo ix wak'och yopisio Winh Rey t'a tzalan Sion, haton jun tzalan sik'b'ilel wu'uj, xcham Jehová chi'.
Haxo Winh Rey Sik'b'ilel chi' tz'alani: Swalkanel tastak ix sna'a Jehová. Ix yal t'ayin: Ha t'a jun k'u tik, tzin ch'oxeli to Wuninal hach.
k'an t'ayin, ol wak'an juntzanh niwak chonhab' yet' masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'ayach.
Ol ak' yajalil t'a yib'anh heb' yet' wal ha poder. Ol ha satel heb' icha tz'aj smak'jipoj junok lum chen t'a junok k'e'en k'okoch, xchi t'ayin, xchi Winh Uninab'il chi'.
Ha tikne'ik jun, hex sreyal, hex yajalil juntzanh chonhab', jelanokab' tzeyutej he pensar, scham wal he k'ayb'an tas swala'.
Ak'ekem he b'a t'a Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal, ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat.
Emnakil tzeyutej pax he b'a t'ay t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, yik max kot yowal t'ayex. Tato ma'ay, ol hex satel yuj, yujto elanhchamel skot yowal. Te tzalajk'olal yik masanil heb' skol sb'a t'a Jehová.
